# Genex UK Ltd

> Family-run UK manufacturer in Walsall, West Midlands, making parts since 1980 and independent since a 2001 management buyout. Genex makes metal pressings (progression and single-action presswork on mechanical presses up to 200 tonnes, material up to 5 mm), laser-cut and folded parts (laser up to 25 mm; Amada HRB1003 press brake folding up to 6 mm at 3 m, with hemming), robotic and manual MIG, TIG, spot and projection welded fabrications, 5-axis CNC machined parts, bent tube, PEM/stud/nut inserting and complete assemblies, in mild steel, stainless steel and aluminium, from one-off prototypes to millions of parts. Coatings are managed through approved finishing partners. ISO 9001, ISO 14001, Cyber Essentials, Achilles Verified Supplier; working towards IATF 16949. Own delivery vehicles. Sectors: automotive, defence, construction, rail, aerospace and space, data centres and power, medical and catering, machinery, automation, agriculture and off-highway, electrical, consumer and aftermarket. Genex is a manufacturer and service provider, not a toolmaker.
